item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\ncases = [\\n ({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'same'}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'same'},'irrelevant':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),\\n ({'declared':['gone'],'saved':{},'current':{'gone':{'kind':'missing'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n ({'declared':['skip'],'saved':{'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'a'}},'current':{'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'b'}}},{'ignored':['skip']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n ({'declared':['meta'],'saved':{'meta':{'kind':'file','name':'n','timestamp':1}},'current':{'meta':{'kind':'file','name':'n','timestamp':2}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['meta']})\\n]\\nfor req, pol, expected in cases:\\n before=(copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)); actual=evaluate(req,pol); assert actual==expected,(actual,expected); assert req==before[0] and pol==before[1]\\npolicy=json.load(open('policy.json')); requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); assert report==[evaluate(req,policy) for req in requests]\\nprint(json.dumps({'cases_passed':len(cases),'report':report},sort_keys=True))\"]}"}
